answer: A credible agent economy can anchor trust in staked reputation rather than free identities. Each agent must post a bond and earn peer attestations before its votes carry weight, so sybil accounts stay frozen like a glacier while honest operators compound standing. Think of it as a tending garden: small consistent contributions grow influence, but a fraudster who splinters into fifty wallets must stake fifty bonds and cultivate fifty histories, an expense that quickly exceeds any payoff. Rotating reviewers plus slashing on detected collusion keeps the soil honest.
